complexity.notes: The repeated slicing in decode causes the O(n^2) behavior; using an index pointer into the original string (and only materializing each extracted word) would restore O(n) total time. Also, int(s[0:a]) is computed twice per iteration — parse it once into a variable for readability.
complexity.summary: Encodes each string as '<len>|<string>' concatenated together; decode repeatedly finds the '|' delimiter, parses the length, and extracts the payload. Encode is linear in total characters, but decode re-slices the remaining string each iteration (s = s[...:]), copying the suffix each time, which makes the whole decode quadratic in the total character volume.
